searchText: Following up on this, today I'll present the FOCIL EIP-7805 as a candidate headliner for Glamsterdam during ACDC #158 (https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1548). I'd encourage everyone who's been working and helping make progress on FOCIL to attend!
